SAY.study: bin/vawe refs list, bin/vawe refs frames <id>, Read the frames at full size, then fill "Taken from" in films/x/brief.md: 4 to 6 frames, exact path and what you take; ask: what does this ref do that a simple film does not?
SAY.moves: bin/vawe frame <ref-id> --cuts on 2 reference films, Read every strip, then name 3 moves in "Taken from" (ref id, cut second) and which of the ten patterns in taste/craft/film-structure.md (The motion grammar) each ref uses; ask: what does the cut do to the eye?
SAY.design: write films/x/DESIGN.md and films/x/kit/ (format: skills/vawe-page/SKILL.md, example: films/examples/colour-sting/kit/; type: taste/craft/typography.md, colour: taste/craft/color.md); ask: which type scale and colour roles still read at this screen size?
SAY.skills: add to films/x/DESIGN.md one line per rung (type, colour): "Skill <rung>: <slug>: what it decided", or "Skipped <rung>: <reason>"; list the skills with command npx -y ui-skills list
SAY.states: build one static state per world in films/x/page.html from the kit, no motion yet (layout: taste/craft/layout.md), then bin/vawe frame films/x/page.html --world all; ask: where is the eye in each frame, and what does it see first?
SAY.ideas: fill "Ideas" in films/x/brief.md (guides/IDEATE.md): for each beat and each cut write the meaning, 4 ideas from 4 different devices with a typicality number, and pick one that is not the most typical, with a reason; ask: what would a typical film do here, and what in this subject's own world does the same job?; then bin/vawe frame films/x/page.html --board lists what the taste docs say about the plan
SAY.board: bin/vawe frame films/x/page.html --board lists what the taste docs say about the plan (stagger gaps, read holds, the last second); then fill "Board" in films/x/brief.md: rhythm, spectacle, a move per cut and its handoff (load skills/vawe-transitions/SKILL.md: the cut's row in the Ideas ledger (guides/IDEATE.md), the less typical pick, the ledger; families: taste/craft/transitions.md; feeling: taste/craft/selection.md), sound (effects on actions, a real recording first, no bed: taste/craft/sound.md); ask: what carries the eye across each cut, what is the rhythm, where is the one big moment, what sound sits on each action?
SAY.cut: Read films/x/footage.md and its contact sheets, then fill the "why" cell of each row in "Cut list" in films/x/brief.md (in and out seconds, rate, and the message line); ask: which action or word ends each clip, and what does the cut keep?
SAY.motion: bin/vawe frame films/x/page.html --cuts and Read every cut at full size; for the spectacle second also bin/vawe frame films/x/page.html --moment <s> --onion and bin/vawe frame films/x/page.html --moment <s> --velocity; check each cut against taste/craft/motion-craft.md and the principles in core/motion/README.md: anticipation on the hero, follow-through and overlap, eased spacing, arcs on travelling elements, secondary action, exits faster than entrances, holds alive through element motion, camera still unless the spectacle; fix what reads flat
SAY.cutCheck: bin/vawe frame films/x/page.html --cuts and Read every cut at full size; check that each cut lands on an action or a word end (films/x/footage/<clip>.words.json has the word times) and each clip holds 1.2 s or more; move the in and out points in the Cut list and the page
SAY.motionRows: write one row per cut in "Motion pass" in films/x/brief.md: each principle checked, what read flat, what you fixed
SAY.plan: no plan to approve: write the Directions and the Board in films/x/brief.md, then go on with bin/vawe dev films/x/page.html and end your message with one line, "If you like it, type /vawe-approve"
SAY.ship: bin/vawe ship films/x/page.html, then bin/vawe wait films/x/page.html (one call waits up to 100 seconds, then says STILL RUNNING: call it again; run it alone, not in parallel); while it renders, fill the brief's Board and Motion pass rows if empty, Read the bin/vawe frame <page> --cuts grids, or prepare the critique notes
